task_description: Add a JA/EN language toggle to the Digital Monster frontend so a US judge can use the app in English. Build a dependency-free in-house i18n layer (Lang type, two complete message dictionaries, useI18n() provider/hook persisted to localStorage key 'ddm.lang', default 'ja'), put the toggle in the header, and translate EVERY user-visible string including the ones added by issues #8 (evolution conditions), #9 (battle animation), #10 (care animations), and #11 (chat speech bubble). Keep JA output byte-identical to today. Where feasible, also make the Bedrock chat AI reply in the selected language by threading an optional lang through ChatRequest -> frontend -> backend chat.ts (default 'ja', backward compatible); this requires an AWS redeploy performed by the orchestrator after merge.
